body: Gurdeep Soni (Chairman & MD) on the Q2FY26 call (2025-11-17), volunteered: "we expect to grow in single digit in this segment year-on-year" Metric: Aftermarket revenue FY26 YoY. Target: +1-9%. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: SILENTLY-DROPPED. Evidence: No FY26 aftermarket growth number disclosed. Language moved from '25-30% growth' (FY25) to 'important business driver' (Nov-25) to 'stable contributor' (Feb/May-26). The implied 9M FY26 decline is ~-14% (share 19% -> 14%). On 2025-11-17 the COO said 'we definitely have not de-grown'. Q1FY27 call (CEO, 2026-08-05): aftermarket 'went from 20% [of revenue] in FY25 to 15% in FY26', i.e. ~INR 193 cr -> ~INR 175 cr, about -9% YoY (re-derived). Management explanation: Tariffs at 50% hit US aftermarket; 25% HSN ruling of 31-Oct-2025 expected to help.
